decisions.choice: a man, a man: any man
decisions.reason: Repeating the noun means "each" or "any" (as in 17:3; 18:6). Verses 2-15 concern a man; verses 19-30 give the matching laws for a woman.

decisions.choice: from his flesh: from his genitals
decisions.reason: "Flesh" is here a modest way of naming the male sexual organ, as it is in Ezekiel 16:26 and 23:20, and for circumcision in Genesis 17:11. The discharge is a flow from the penis, not from a wound or sore elsewhere on the body. In verse 7 "flesh" has its ordinary sense, the man's body, and in verse 19 it is used in the same modest way of a woman.

decisions.choice: discharge: an abnormal flow, a sign of illness
decisions.reason: The verb means to flow or run, and is used of water (Psalm 78:20) and of a land flowing with milk and honey (Exodus 3:8). Here it is a lasting flow that is not semen, which verse 16 treats separately; it is a sickness the man must recover from (verse 13). The text does not name the illness, and a flow of pus or mucus from an infection fits what it describes.

decisions.choice: unclean it is: the discharge is unclean, and makes the man unclean
decisions.reason: The pronoun can refer to the discharge or to the man; either way the discharge is the source of uncleanness, and the man and what he touches are unclean because of it (verses 3-12).

decisions.choice: a discharge from his body
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable keep the modesty of the Hebrew with "from his body" rather than naming the organ; the meaning decision says what is meant. Literal keeps "flesh".

decisions.choice: "flujo" for the discharge, at every level and through the chapter ("el hombre que tiene el flujo")
decisions.reason: "Flujo" is the ordinary, sober word for a flow from the body and does not name a particular illness, as the Hebrew does not.

decisions.choice: "un écoulement" for the discharge, at every level and through the chapter ("l'homme qui a l'écoulement")
decisions.reason: "Écoulement" is the plain, neutral word for a flow from the body, used for illness without naming one; "flux" is older and less clear to readers today.

decisions.choice: "Parlez", "dites" (vous)
decisions.reason: The command is plural in Hebrew: it is given to Moses and Aaron together (verse 1).

decisions.choice: "kutokwa na majimaji" (to have a discharge of fluid), "majimaji" for the discharge, through the chapter
decisions.reason: "Majimaji" names a fluid flow plainly and decently without naming a disease; "usaha" (pus) would decide what the text leaves open.

en.B: This is the uncleanness his discharge brings: whether his body lets the discharge flow or it is stopped up, either way he is unclean.
en.R: The discharge may keep flowing, or it may be stopped up. Either way, he is unclean.

decisions.choice: runs ... is blocked: whether the discharge flows freely or is held back
decisions.reason: The first verb, found only here, means to flow or drip; the second means to be sealed or stopped. The man is unclean while the illness lasts, even when nothing is flowing at the moment.

decisions.choice: the shorter Hebrew text
alternatives: a longer text that repeats the description and adds "all the days of his body's discharge"
decisions.reason: The Masoretic text, which we follow, is short here. The Septuagint, the Samaritan Pentateuch and a Leviticus scroll from Qumran have a longer form of the verse, which repeats the two cases and says that he is unclean all the days of the discharge. The meaning is the same either way. Reviewers should check the wording of the longer text.

decisions.choice: his body / it

decisions.reason: What he lies or sits on becomes unclean in its turn, and passes uncleanness on to anyone who touches it (verses 5-6). The same holds for a woman's bed and seat in verses 20-26.

decisions.choice: article: any object, here something used as a seat
decisions.reason: The word covers any made thing: a tool, a dish, a piece of furniture. With "he sits on" it means a stool, a chair or anything he uses to sit on.

decisions.choice: wash his garments and bathe: wash clothes and body
decisions.reason: The first verb is used for washing clothes, the second for washing the body. Touching something that the unclean man has made unclean requires both, as touching the carcass of an unclean animal does when it is carried (11:25, 28).

decisions.choice: unclean until the evening: a lesser uncleanness that ends at sunset
decisions.reason: See 11:24. The uncleanness passed on in this way is lighter than the man's own: it lasts a day, needs no offering, and ends with the washing and the evening.

decisions.choice: anyone / whoever
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "a man" here means any person, man or woman, who touches the bed. Literal gives "anyone" with "a man" as the alternative; Balanced and Readable use "whoever" and "anyone" and the singular "they".

decisions.choice: "Quiconque ... il"
decisions.reason: French has no singular "they"; "quiconque" takes in any man or woman, and the generic masculine "il" follows it, as through the rest of the chapter.

decisions.reason: Fluids from his body carry the uncleanness as his touch does. Spitting on someone was also an insult (Numbers 12:14; Deuteronomy 25:9), but here the law is concerned only with uncleanness.

decisions.choice: that person
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says only "he will wash". Balanced and Readable name the person who was spat on, so that the reader does not take it to be the man with the discharge.

source.text: וְכָל־הַמֶּרְכָּ֗ב אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִרְכַּ֥ב עָלָ֛יו הַזָּ֖ב יִטְמָֽא׃

records.literal_gloss: And every saddle which rides on it the [one] discharging will be unclean.

en.L: And every saddle on which the one with the discharge rides will be unclean.
en.B: Any saddle the man with the discharge rides on becomes unclean.
en.R: If the man with the discharge rides on a saddle, it becomes unclean.

es.L: Y toda montura sobre la que cabalgue el que tiene flujo será impura.
es.B: Toda montura en la que cabalgue el hombre que tiene el flujo queda impura.
es.R: Si el hombre que tiene el flujo va montado en una silla de montar, la silla queda impura.

fr.L: Et toute selle sur laquelle montera celui qui a l’écoulement sera impure.
fr.B: Toute selle sur laquelle monte l’homme qui a l’écoulement devient impure.
fr.R: Si l’homme qui a l’écoulement monte sur une selle, elle devient impure.

sw.L: Na kila tandiko atakalolipanda yule anayetokwa na majimaji litakuwa najisi.
sw.B: Tandiko lolote analolipanda mwanamume anayetokwa na majimaji linakuwa najisi.
sw.R: Mwanamume anayetokwa na majimaji akipanda juu ya tandiko, tandiko hilo linakuwa najisi.

decisions.choice: saddle: the seat on a riding animal
decisions.reason: The noun comes from the verb to ride. It is the seat or blanket on a donkey or a camel, or the seat of a cart (the same word is used of the seat of a carried couch in Song of Songs 3:10). Like the bed and the stool (verse 4), it bears his weight.

source.text: וְכָל־הַנֹּגֵ֗עַ בְּכֹל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִהְיֶ֣ה תַחְתָּ֔יו יִטְמָ֖א עַד־הָעָ֑רֶב וְהַנּוֹשֵׂ֣א אוֹתָ֔ם יְכַבֵּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃

records.literal_gloss: And everyone touching anything that will be under him will be unclean until the evening, and the [one] carrying them will wash his garments and bathe in water and will be unclean until the evening.

en.L: And everyone who touches anything that was under him will be unclean until the evening, and the one who carries them will wash his garments and bathe in water and be unclean until the evening.
en.B: Anyone who touches anything that was under him will be unclean until evening, and whoever carries such things is to wash their clothes and bathe in water, and they remain unclean until evening.
en.R: Anyone who touches anything the man has been lying or sitting on will be unclean until evening. Anyone who picks up those things becomes unclean too. They must wash their clothes and take a bath. They will be unclean until evening.

es.L: Y todo el que toque cualquier cosa que haya estado debajo de él quedará impuro hasta la tarde; y el que las lleve lavará sus ropas y se bañará en agua, y quedará impuro hasta la tarde.
es.B: Quien toque algo que haya estado debajo de él quedará impuro hasta la tarde, y quien cargue esas cosas lavará su ropa y se bañará en agua, y quedará impuro hasta la tarde.
es.R: Quien toque algo en lo que el hombre se haya acostado o sentado quedará impuro hasta la tarde. Quien levante esas cosas también queda impuro. Tiene que lavar su ropa y bañarse. Quedará impuro hasta la tarde.

fr.L: Et quiconque touchera quoi que ce soit qui aura été sous lui sera impur jusqu’au soir ; et celui qui les portera lavera ses vêtements et se baignera dans l’eau, et sera impur jusqu’au soir.
fr.B: Quiconque touche une chose qui a été sous lui sera impur jusqu’au soir, et quiconque transporte ces choses lavera ses vêtements et se baignera dans l’eau, et il restera impur jusqu’au soir.
fr.R: Quiconque touche une chose sur laquelle l’homme s’est couché ou assis sera impur jusqu’au soir. Quiconque soulève ces choses devient impur aussi. Il doit laver ses vêtements et prendre un bain. Il restera impur jusqu’au soir.

sw.L: Na kila mtu atakayegusa kitu chochote kilichokuwa chini yake atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni; na yule atakayevibeba atafua nguo zake na kuoga kwa maji, naye atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni.
sw.B: Mtu yeyote anayegusa kitu chochote kilichokuwa chini yake atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni, na mtu yeyote anayebeba vitu hivyo atafua nguo zake na kuoga kwa maji, naye atabaki najisi mpaka jioni.
sw.R: Mtu yeyote anayegusa kitu ambacho mwanamume huyo amekilalia au kukikalia atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni. Mtu yeyote anayebeba vitu hivyo naye anakuwa najisi. Lazima afue nguo zake na kuoga. Atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni.

decisions.choice: under him: whatever he has lain or sat on
decisions.reason: The phrase gathers up the bed, the seat and the saddle of verses 4-9.

decisions.choice: touching ... carrying: carrying brings a stronger uncleanness
decisions.reason: Touching such a thing makes a person unclean until evening, without washing (as in verses 19 and 23). Carrying it, which means handling it for longer, also requires washing clothes and bathing, as with the carcasses of 11:24-25.

decisions.choice: lying or sitting on
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what "under him" means.

source.text: וְכֹ֨ל אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִגַּע־בּוֹ֙ הַזָּ֔ב וְיָדָ֖יו לֹא־שָׁטַ֣ף בַּמָּ֑יִם וְכִבֶּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃

records.literal_gloss: And everyone whom touches him the [one] discharging, and his hands not he has rinsed in water, and he will wash his garments and bathe in water and will be unclean until the evening.

en.L: And everyone whom the one with the discharge touches without having rinsed his hands in water, he will wash his garments and bathe in water and be unclean until the evening.
en.B: If the man with the discharge touches someone without first rinsing his hands in water, that person is to wash their clothes and bathe in water, and they remain unclean until evening.
en.R: The man with the discharge must rinse his hands with water before he touches anyone. If he does not, the person he touches becomes unclean. They must wash their clothes and take a bath. They will be unclean until evening.

es.L: Y todo aquel a quien toque el que tiene flujo sin haberse enjuagado las manos en agua lavará sus ropas y se bañará en agua, y quedará impuro hasta la tarde.
es.B: Si el hombre que tiene el flujo toca a alguien sin haberse enjuagado antes las manos en agua, esa persona lavará su ropa y se bañará en agua, y quedará impura hasta la tarde.
es.R: El hombre que tiene el flujo tiene que enjuagarse las manos con agua antes de tocar a alguien. Si no lo hace, la persona a quien toca queda impura. Tiene que lavar su ropa y bañarse. Quedará impura hasta la tarde.

fr.L: Et quiconque sera touché par celui qui a l’écoulement sans qu’il ait rincé ses mains dans l’eau lavera ses vêtements et se baignera dans l’eau, et sera impur jusqu’au soir.
fr.B: Si l’homme qui a l’écoulement touche quelqu’un sans s’être d’abord rincé les mains dans l’eau, cette personne lavera ses vêtements et se baignera dans l’eau, et elle restera impure jusqu’au soir.
fr.R: L’homme qui a l’écoulement doit se rincer les mains avec de l’eau avant de toucher quelqu’un. S’il ne le fait pas, la personne qu’il touche devient impure. Elle doit laver ses vêtements et prendre un bain. Elle restera impure jusqu’au soir.

sw.L: Na kila mtu atakayeguswa na yule anayetokwa na majimaji bila yeye kusuuza mikono yake kwa maji, atafua nguo zake na kuoga kwa maji, naye atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni.
sw.B: Mwanamume anayetokwa na majimaji akimgusa mtu bila kusuuza kwanza mikono yake kwa maji, mtu huyo atafua nguo zake na kuoga kwa maji, naye atabaki najisi mpaka jioni.
sw.R: Mwanamume anayetokwa na majimaji lazima asuuze mikono yake kwa maji kabla ya kumgusa mtu. Asipofanya hivyo, mtu anayemgusa anakuwa najisi. Lazima mtu huyo afue nguo zake na kuoga. Atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni.

decisions.choice: his hands not rinsed: the man with the discharge has not washed his hands
decisions.reason: "His hands" are the hands of the man with the discharge. Rinsing them first keeps his touch from passing on the uncleanness, which shows that the law limits its spread and does not cut him off from all contact.

decisions.choice: must rinse his hands ... If he does not
decisions.reason: Readable states the rinsing as a rule first and then what happens if it is left undone. It does not add to the law: the verse implies that rinsed hands do not pass on the uncleanness.

source.text: וּכְלִי־חֶ֛רֶשׂ אֲשֶׁר־יִגַּע־בּ֥וֹ הַזָּ֖ב יִשָּׁבֵ֑ר וְכָל־כְּלִי־עֵ֔ץ יִשָּׁטֵ֖ף בַּמָּֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: And a vessel of earthenware which touches it the [one] discharging will be broken, and every vessel of wood will be rinsed in water.

en.L: And an earthenware vessel that the one with the discharge touches will be broken, and every wooden vessel will be rinsed in water.
en.B: If the man with the discharge touches a clay pot, it is to be broken; if he touches a wooden container, it is to be rinsed in water.
en.R: If the man with the discharge touches a clay pot, it must be broken. If he touches a wooden bowl or box, it must be rinsed with water.

es.L: Y la vasija de barro que toque el que tiene flujo será quebrada, y todo utensilio de madera será enjuagado en agua.
es.B: Si el hombre que tiene el flujo toca una olla de barro, se debe romper; si toca un recipiente de madera, se debe enjuagar en agua.
es.R: Si el hombre que tiene el flujo toca una olla de barro, hay que romperla. Si toca un tazón o una caja de madera, hay que enjuagar el objeto con agua.

fr.L: Et le vase de terre que touchera celui qui a l’écoulement sera brisé, et tout ustensile de bois sera rincé dans l’eau.
fr.B: Si l’homme qui a l’écoulement touche un pot en terre cuite, on le brisera ; s’il touche un récipient en bois, on le rincera dans l’eau.
fr.R: Si l’homme qui a l’écoulement touche un pot en terre, il faut le casser. S’il touche un bol ou une boîte en bois, il faut rincer l’objet avec de l’eau.

sw.L: Na chombo cha udongo atakachokigusa yule anayetokwa na majimaji kitavunjwa, na kila chombo cha mti kitasuuzwa kwa maji.
sw.B: Mwanamume anayetokwa na majimaji akigusa chungu cha udongo, kitavunjwa; akigusa chombo cha mbao, kitasuuzwa kwa maji.
sw.R: Mwanamume anayetokwa na majimaji akigusa chungu cha udongo, lazima kivunjwe. Akigusa bakuli au sanduku la mbao, lazima kitu hicho kisuuzwe kwa maji.

decisions.choice: clay is broken, wood is rinsed
decisions.reason: Unglazed clay soaks up what touches it and cannot be made clean, so it is broken (6:21; 11:33). Wood can be washed (11:32).

decisions.choice: If he touches ... if he touches
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable repeat the condition for the wooden vessel, which the Hebrew leaves to be understood from the first half.

source.text: וְכִֽי־יִטְהַ֤ר הַזָּב֙ מִזּוֹב֔וֹ וְסָ֨פַר ל֜וֹ שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֛ים לְטָהֳרָת֖וֹ וְכִבֶּ֣ס בְּגָדָ֑יו וְרָחַ֧ץ בְּשָׂר֛וֹ בְּמַ֥יִם חַיִּ֖ים וְטָהֵֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And when is clean the [one] discharging from his discharge, and he will count for himself seven days for his cleansing, and he will wash his garments and bathe his flesh in living water and he will be clean.

en.L: And when the one with the discharge is clean from his discharge, he will count for himself seven days for his cleansing, and he will wash his garments and bathe his flesh in living water, and he will be clean.
en.B: When the man with the discharge is healed of it, he is to count seven days for his cleansing. Then he is to wash his clothes and bathe his body in fresh water, and he will be clean.
en.R: When the man's discharge stops, he must wait seven days to be made clean. Then he must wash his clothes and bathe in fresh water. After that he will be clean.

es.L: Y cuando el que tiene flujo quede puro de su flujo, contará para sí siete días para su purificación; lavará sus ropas y bañará su carne en agua viva, y quedará puro.
es.B: Cuando el hombre que tiene el flujo se haya sanado de él, contará siete días para su purificación. Después lavará su ropa y bañará su cuerpo en agua corriente, y quedará puro.
es.R: Cuando al hombre se le detenga el flujo, tiene que esperar siete días para quedar puro. Después tiene que lavar su ropa y bañarse en agua corriente. Entonces quedará puro.

fr.L: Et quand celui qui a l’écoulement sera pur de son écoulement, il comptera pour lui sept jours pour sa purification ; il lavera ses vêtements et baignera sa chair dans de l’eau vive, et il sera pur.
fr.B: Quand l’homme qui a l’écoulement en sera guéri, il comptera sept jours pour sa purification. Puis il lavera ses vêtements et baignera son corps dans de l’eau courante, et il sera pur.
fr.R: Quand l’écoulement de l’homme s’arrête, il doit attendre sept jours pour être purifié. Ensuite il doit laver ses vêtements et prendre un bain dans de l’eau courante. Après cela, il sera pur.

sw.L: Na yule anayetokwa na majimaji atakapokuwa safi kutoka majimaji yake, atajihesabia siku saba kwa ajili ya kusafishwa kwake; atafua nguo zake na kuoga mwili wake katika maji yaliyo hai, naye atakuwa safi.
sw.B: Mwanamume anayetokwa na majimaji akipona, atahesabu siku saba za kusafishwa kwake. Kisha atafua nguo zake na kuoga mwili wake kwa maji yanayotiririka, naye atakuwa safi.
sw.R: Majimaji ya mwanamume huyo yakikoma, lazima asubiri siku saba ili asafishwe. Kisha lazima afue nguo zake na kuoga kwa maji yanayotiririka. Baada ya hapo atakuwa safi.

decisions.choice: is clean from his discharge: the flow has stopped
decisions.reason: The first "clean" means that the illness has ended. The seven days, the washing and the offerings of verses 14-15 then make him ritually clean.

decisions.choice: living water: fresh water from a spring or stream
decisions.reason: See 14:5. Only here in the chapter does the washing call for running water, for the man's own cleansing at the end of his illness.

decisions.choice: his flesh: his body
decisions.reason: Here "flesh" is the whole body that he bathes, as in verse 16.

decisions.choice: is healed of it / stops
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what being "clean from his discharge" means, to keep it apart from the ritual cleanness that follows. Literal keeps "clean".

decisions.choice: "agua viva" (L); "agua corriente" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew image; Balanced and Readable name running water from a spring or stream.

decisions.choice: "de l'eau vive" (L); "de l'eau courante" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew image of living water; Balanced and Readable say what it is, water that flows from a spring or stream.

decisions.choice: "maji yaliyo hai" (L); "maji yanayotiririka" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew "living water"; Balanced and Readable say it is flowing water, from a spring or stream.

source.text: וּבַיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁמִינִ֗י יִֽקַּֽח־לוֹ֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י תֹרִ֔ים א֥וֹ שְׁנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יוֹנָ֑ה וּבָ֣א׀לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֗ה אֶל־פֶּ֨תַח֙ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד וּנְתָנָ֖ם אֶל־הַכֹּהֵֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: And on the day the eighth he will take for himself two turtledoves or two young ones of a dove and come before Yahweh to [the] entrance of [the] tent of meeting and give them to the priest.

en.L: And on the eighth day he will take for himself two turtledoves or two young pigeons, and come before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} to the entrance of the tent of meeting and give them to the priest.
en.B: On the eighth day he is to get two turtledoves or two young pigeons and bring them before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} to the entrance of the tent of meeting, where he gives them to the priest.
en.R: On the eighth day he must get two turtledoves or two young pigeons. He must come to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} at the entrance of the meeting tent and give the birds to the priest.

es.L: Y el octavo día tomará para sí dos tórtolas o dos pichones, y vendrá delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} a la entrada de la Tienda del Encuentro y se los dará al sacerdote.
es.B: El octavo día conseguirá dos tórtolas o dos pichones y los llevará delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, a la entrada de la Tienda del Encuentro, donde se los entregará al sacerdote.
es.R: El octavo día tiene que conseguir dos palomas o dos pichones. Tiene que presentarse ante {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} a la entrada de la Tienda del Encuentro y darle las aves al sacerdote.

fr.L: Et le huitième jour, il prendra pour lui deux tourterelles ou deux jeunes pigeons, et il viendra devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} à l’entrée de la tente de la Rencontre, et il les donnera au prêtre.
fr.B: Le huitième jour, il prendra deux tourterelles ou deux jeunes pigeons et les apportera devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, à l’entrée de la tente de la Rencontre, où il les remettra au prêtre.
fr.R: Le huitième jour, il doit prendre deux colombes ou deux jeunes pigeons. Il doit venir devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} à l’entrée de la tente de la Rencontre et donner les oiseaux au prêtre.

sw.L: Na siku ya nane atajitwalia hua wawili au makinda mawili ya njiwa, naye atakuja mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} mlangoni pa Hema la Kukutania na kumpa kuhani.
sw.B: Siku ya nane atapata hua wawili au makinda mawili ya njiwa, na kuwaleta mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} mlangoni pa Hema la Kukutania, na hapo atampa kuhani.
sw.R: Siku ya nane lazima apate hua wawili au makinda mawili ya njiwa. Lazima aje mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} mlangoni pa Hema la Kukutania na kumpa kuhani ndege hao.

decisions.choice: two turtledoves or two young pigeons: the smallest offering
decisions.reason: These birds are the offering of the poor in 5:7 and 12:8. Here they are required of every man, rich or poor, as for the Nazirite who is made unclean (Numbers 6:10).

decisions.choice: before the LORD: at the sanctuary, in his presence
decisions.reason: To come before the LORD is to come to the entrance of the tent of meeting, where God meets his people (1:1-3). Now clean, the man may come there again.

source.text: וְעָשָׂ֤ה אֹתָם֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן אֶחָ֣ד חַטָּ֔את וְהָאֶחָ֖ד עֹלָ֑ה וְכִפֶּ֨ר עָלָ֧יו הַכֹּהֵ֛ן לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מִזּוֹבֽוֹ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And will offer them the priest, one [as] a sin offering and the one [as] a burnt offering, and will make atonement for him the priest before Yahweh from his discharge.

en.L: And the priest will offer them, one [as] a sin offering and the other [as] a burnt offering, and the priest will make atonement for him before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for his discharge.
en.B: The priest is to offer one bird as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering, and so make atonement for him before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} on account of his discharge.
en.R: The priest must offer one bird as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering. In this way the priest will make atonement for the man before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} because of his discharge.

es.L: Y el sacerdote los ofrecerá, uno [como] sacrificio por el pecado y el otro [como] holocausto, y el sacerdote hará expiación por él delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} por su flujo.
es.B: El sacerdote ofrecerá un ave como sacrificio por el pecado y la otra como holocausto, y así hará expiación por él delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} a causa de su flujo.
es.R: El sacerdote tiene que ofrecer un ave como sacrificio por el pecado y la otra como holocausto. Así el sacerdote hará expiación por el hombre delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} a causa de su flujo.

fr.L: Et le prêtre les offrira, l’un [en] sacrifice pour le péché et l’autre [en] holocauste, et le prêtre fera l’expiation pour lui devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} pour son écoulement.
fr.B: Le prêtre offrira un oiseau en sacrifice pour le péché et l’autre en holocauste ; il fera ainsi l’expiation pour lui devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} à cause de son écoulement.
fr.R: Le prêtre doit offrir un oiseau en sacrifice pour le péché et l’autre en holocauste. De cette façon, le prêtre fera l’expiation pour cet homme devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} à cause de son écoulement.

sw.L: Na kuhani atawatoa, mmoja [kuwa] sadaka ya dhambi na mwingine [kuwa] sadaka ya kuteketezwa, na kuhani atafanya upatanisho kwa ajili yake mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa sababu ya majimaji yake.
sw.B: Kuhani atamtoa ndege mmoja kuwa sadaka ya dhambi na mwingine kuwa sadaka ya kuteketezwa, na hivyo atamfanyia upatanisho mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa sababu ya majimaji yake.
sw.R: Lazima kuhani amtoe ndege mmoja kuwa sadaka ya dhambi na mwingine kuwa sadaka ya kuteketezwa. Kwa njia hii kuhani atamfanyia mwanamume huyo upatanisho mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa sababu ya majimaji yake.

decisions.choice: make atonement for him from his discharge: cleanse him from its uncleanness
decisions.reason: The discharge was an illness, not a sin. The sin offering (4:3) cleanses the uncleanness it brought, and the burnt offering (1:3) restores the man to the worship of God, as for the mother in 12:7-8.

source.text: וְאִ֕ישׁ כִּֽי־תֵצֵ֥א מִמֶּ֖נּוּ שִׁכְבַת־זָ֑רַע וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֛יִם אֶת־כָּל־בְּשָׂר֖וֹ וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃

records.literal_gloss: And a man when goes out from him a laying of seed, and he will bathe in water all his flesh and will be unclean until the evening.

en.L: And a man, when an emission of semen goes out from him, will bathe all his flesh in water and be unclean until the evening.
en.B: If semen comes out of a man, he is to bathe his whole body in water, and he remains unclean until evening.
en.R: Semen may come out of a man's body. When that happens, he must wash his whole body with water. He will be unclean until evening.

es.L: Y el hombre, cuando salga de él emisión de semen, bañará en agua toda su carne, y quedará impuro hasta la tarde.
es.B: Si a un hombre le sale semen, bañará todo su cuerpo en agua, y quedará impuro hasta la tarde.
es.R: Puede ser que a un hombre le salga semen del cuerpo. Cuando eso pase, tiene que lavarse todo el cuerpo con agua. Quedará impuro hasta la tarde.

fr.L: Et un homme, quand il sortira de lui une émission de semence, baignera toute sa chair dans l’eau, et sera impur jusqu’au soir.
fr.B: Si de la semence sort du corps d’un homme, il baignera tout son corps dans l’eau, et il restera impur jusqu’au soir.
fr.R: Il peut arriver que de la semence sorte du corps d’un homme. Dans ce cas, il doit se laver tout le corps avec de l’eau. Il sera impur jusqu’au soir.

sw.L: Na mwanamume, shahawa zitakapomtoka, ataoga mwili wake wote kwa maji, naye atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni.
sw.B: Mwanamume akitokwa na shahawa, ataoga mwili wake wote kwa maji, naye atabaki najisi mpaka jioni.
sw.R: Huenda mwanamume akatokwa na shahawa. Hilo likitokea, lazima aoge mwili wake wote kwa maji. Atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni.

decisions.choice: a laying of seed: an emission of semen
decisions.reason: The phrase joins "seed" with a noun from the verb to lie down, and means the semen that a man releases. It is used again in verses 17, 18 and 32, and of intercourse in 19:20 and Numbers 5:13.

decisions.choice: an emission apart from intercourse: a normal event, a brief uncleanness
decisions.reason: This verse deals with a man alone, as in a release of semen during sleep (Deuteronomy 23:10-11); verse 18 deals with intercourse. Unlike the discharge of verses 2-15, this is a normal part of life and no sin. He bathes, is unclean only until evening, and brings no offering. The uncleanness kept him from holy things for that day (22:4).

decisions.choice: "emisión de semen" (L); "semen" (B, R), here and in verses 17, 18 and 32
decisions.reason: "Semen" is the ordinary, sober word in Spanish; "simiente" sounds archaic and could be read as seed for sowing.

decisions.choice: "une émission de semence" (L); "de la semence" (B, R), here and in verses 17, 18 and 32
decisions.reason: "Semence" is plain and decent in French; "sperme" is clinical. Literal keeps a noun phrase for the Hebrew "laying of seed".

decisions.choice: "shahawa", "kutokwa na shahawa", here and in verses 17, 18 and 32
decisions.reason: "Shahawa" is the standard, decent Swahili word; "mbegu" would be read as seed for planting.

source.text: וְכָל־בֶּ֣גֶד וְכָל־ע֔וֹר אֲשֶׁר־יִהְיֶ֥ה עָלָ֖יו שִׁכְבַת־זָ֑רַע וְכֻבַּ֥ס בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And every garment and every skin which will be on it a laying of seed, and it will be washed in water and will be unclean until the evening.

en.L: And every garment and every skin on which there is an emission of semen will be washed in water and be unclean until the evening.
en.B: If semen gets on any piece of clothing or leather, it is to be washed in water and will stay unclean until evening.
en.R: If semen gets on clothing or on anything made of leather, it must be washed with water. It will be unclean until evening.

es.L: Y toda ropa y toda piel sobre la que haya emisión de semen será lavada en agua y quedará impura hasta la tarde.
es.B: Si el semen cae sobre alguna prenda de vestir o algo de cuero, se lavará en agua y quedará impuro hasta la tarde.
es.R: Si el semen cae sobre la ropa o sobre algo hecho de cuero, hay que lavarlo con agua. Quedará impuro hasta la tarde.

fr.L: Et tout vêtement et toute peau sur lesquels il y aura une émission de semence seront lavés dans l’eau et seront impurs jusqu’au soir.
fr.B: Si de la semence tombe sur un vêtement ou sur un objet en cuir, on le lavera dans l’eau, et il restera impur jusqu’au soir.
fr.R: Si de la semence tombe sur un vêtement ou sur quelque chose en cuir, il faut le laver avec de l’eau. Il sera impur jusqu’au soir.

sw.L: Na kila vazi na kila ngozi vitakavyokuwa na shahawa vitafuliwa kwa maji, navyo vitakuwa najisi mpaka jioni.
sw.B: Shahawa zikiingia kwenye nguo yoyote au kitu cha ngozi, kitu hicho kitafuliwa kwa maji, nacho kitabaki najisi mpaka jioni.
sw.R: Shahawa zikiingia kwenye nguo au kwenye kitu kilichotengenezwa kwa ngozi, lazima kifuliwe kwa maji. Kitakuwa najisi mpaka jioni.

decisions.choice: skin: leather, or a hide used as a covering
decisions.reason: The word means the skin of an animal, and so anything made of leather (as in 13:48). Clothing and leather alike can be washed and made clean.

source.text: וְאִשָּׁ֕ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִשְׁכַּ֥ב אִ֛ישׁ אֹתָ֖הּ שִׁכְבַת־זָ֑רַע וְרָחֲצ֣וּ בַמַּ֔יִם וְטָמְא֖וּ עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃

records.literal_gloss: And a woman whom lies a man with her [with] a laying of seed, and they will bathe in water and will be unclean until the evening.

en.L: And a woman with whom a man lies [with] an emission of semen, they will bathe in water and be unclean until the evening.
en.B: When a man lies with a woman and semen is released, both of them are to bathe in water, and they remain unclean until evening.
en.R: When a man and a woman sleep together and his semen comes out, they both must take a bath. They will be unclean until evening.

es.L: Y la mujer con quien se acueste un hombre [con] emisión de semen: se bañarán en agua y quedarán impuros hasta la tarde.
es.B: Cuando un hombre se acuesta con una mujer y hay emisión de semen, los dos se bañarán en agua y quedarán impuros hasta la tarde.
es.R: Cuando un hombre y una mujer tienen relaciones y a él le sale el semen, los dos tienen que bañarse. Quedarán impuros hasta la tarde.

fr.L: Et une femme avec qui un homme couchera [avec] émission de semence : ils se baigneront dans l’eau et seront impurs jusqu’au soir.
fr.B: Quand un homme couche avec une femme et que sa semence se répand, tous deux se baigneront dans l’eau, et ils resteront impurs jusqu’au soir.
fr.R: Quand un homme et une femme couchent ensemble et que la semence de l’homme sort, ils doivent tous les deux prendre un bain. Ils seront impurs jusqu’au soir.

sw.L: Na mwanamke ambaye mwanamume atalala naye [pamoja na] kutokwa na shahawa, wataoga kwa maji, nao watakuwa najisi mpaka jioni.
sw.B: Mwanamume akilala na mwanamke na shahawa zikatoka, wote wawili wataoga kwa maji, nao watabaki najisi mpaka jioni.
sw.R: Mwanamume na mwanamke wakilala pamoja na shahawa zake zikatoka, lazima wote wawili waoge. Watakuwa najisi mpaka jioni.

decisions.choice: a man lies with her with an emission of semen: sexual intercourse
decisions.reason: "Lie with" is the usual way of speaking of sexual intercourse (Genesis 26:10; Leviticus 19:20). The verse speaks of husband and wife; other laws deal with unlawful unions (chapters 18 and 20).

decisions.choice: both bathe and are unclean until evening: intercourse kept apart from holy things
decisions.reason: Marriage and intercourse are not wrong; the law makes them a brief uncleanness, so that sex was kept apart from worship. For the same reason the people kept away from women before God spoke at Sinai (Exodus 19:15), and David's men had to be kept from women to eat the holy bread (1 Samuel 21:5).

decisions.choice: sleep together
decisions.reason: Readable uses "sleep together", the plain modern idiom for sexual intercourse. Balanced keeps "lies with".

decisions.choice: "tienen relaciones"
decisions.reason: Readable needs the plain modern idiom for intercourse; in Spanish "tener relaciones" is the usual decent expression, while "dormir juntos" can be taken literally.

source.text: וְאִשָּׁה֙ כִּֽי־תִהְיֶ֣ה זָבָ֔ה דָּ֛ם יִהְיֶ֥ה זֹבָ֖הּ בִּבְשָׂרָ֑הּ שִׁבְעַ֤ת יָמִים֙ תִּהְיֶ֣ה בְנִדָּתָ֔הּ וְכָל־הַנֹּגֵ֥עַ בָּ֖הּ יִטְמָ֥א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃

records.literal_gloss: And a woman when she is discharging, blood is her discharge in her flesh, seven days she will be in her menstrual impurity, and everyone touching her will be unclean until the evening.

en.L: And a woman, when she has a discharge [and] her discharge in her flesh is blood, she will be seven days in her menstrual impurity, and everyone who touches her will be unclean until the evening.
en.B: When a woman has a discharge, and what flows from her body is blood, her monthly period keeps her unclean for seven days. Anyone who touches her will be unclean until evening.
en.R: When a woman has her monthly period, she is unclean for seven days. Anyone who touches her will be unclean until evening.

es.L: Y la mujer, cuando tenga flujo [y] su flujo en su carne sea sangre, estará siete días en su impureza menstrual, y todo el que la toque quedará impuro hasta la tarde.
es.B: Cuando una mujer tenga flujo, y lo que sale de su cuerpo sea sangre, su menstruación la hace impura durante siete días. Quien la toque quedará impuro hasta la tarde.
es.R: Cuando una mujer tiene su menstruación, es impura durante siete días. Quien la toque quedará impuro hasta la tarde.

fr.L: Et une femme, quand elle aura un écoulement [et que] son écoulement dans sa chair sera du sang, elle sera sept jours dans son impureté menstruelle, et quiconque la touchera sera impur jusqu’au soir.
fr.B: Quand une femme a un écoulement, et que ce qui coule de son corps est du sang, ses règles la rendent impure pendant sept jours. Quiconque la touche sera impur jusqu’au soir.
fr.R: Quand une femme a ses règles, elle est impure pendant sept jours. Quiconque la touche sera impur jusqu’au soir.

sw.L: Na mwanamke, atakapotokwa na majimaji, [na] majimaji yake mwilini mwake ni damu, atakuwa siku saba katika unajisi wa hedhi yake, na kila mtu atakayemgusa atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni.
sw.B: Mwanamke akitokwa na majimaji, na kinachotoka mwilini mwake ni damu, hedhi yake itamfanya kuwa najisi kwa siku saba. Mtu yeyote atakayemgusa atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni.
sw.R: Mwanamke akiwa katika hedhi yake, atakuwa najisi kwa siku saba. Mtu yeyote atakayemgusa atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni.

decisions.choice: a discharge of blood from her flesh: menstruation, the monthly period
decisions.reason: As in verse 2, "flesh" is a modest word, here for the woman's genitals. The verse describes a woman's regular period, which lasts for a set seven days; verse 25 deals with bleeding that is not regular. Like a man's emission of semen (verse 16), it is a normal part of life, and it brings no offering.

decisions.choice: menstrual impurity: the state of a woman during her period
decisions.reason: The noun names menstruation and the uncleanness it brings (12:2, 5; 15:33; 18:19). It is often linked to a root meaning to put away or keep apart, since a woman was kept from holy things during these days. Elsewhere it came to mean anything defiling (Ezra 9:11).

decisions.choice: touching her: a one-day uncleanness
decisions.reason: Anyone who touches the woman is unclean until evening. The text does not say that they must wash, in contrast to touching her bed or seat (verses 21-22); it also does not forbid touching her. Her household could care for her as usual.

decisions.choice: her monthly period
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the period in plain words. Literal keeps "her menstrual impurity", which says that the period is a state of uncleanness.

decisions.choice: "su impureza menstrual" (L); "su menstruación" (B, R), through the chapter
decisions.reason: "Menstruación" is understood and decent in every Spanish-speaking country; "regla" and "período" vary by region.

decisions.choice: "son impureté menstruelle" (L); "ses règles" (B, R), through the chapter
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew sense of a state of impurity; Balanced and Readable use the everyday word for the monthly period, which is plain without being clinical.

decisions.choice: "unajisi wa hedhi yake" (L); "hedhi yake" (B, R), through the chapter
decisions.reason: "Hedhi" is the standard, respectful Swahili word for the monthly period; Literal adds "unajisi" for the state of impurity the Hebrew word names.

source.text: וְכֹל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּשְׁכַּ֥ב עָלָ֛יו בְּנִדָּתָ֖הּ יִטְמָ֑א וְכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־תֵּשֵׁ֥ב עָלָ֖יו יִטְמָֽא׃

records.literal_gloss: And all that she lies on it in her menstrual impurity will be unclean, and all that she sits on it will be unclean.

en.L: And everything on which she lies in her menstrual impurity will be unclean, and everything on which she sits will be unclean.
en.B: During her period, whatever she lies on and whatever she sits on becomes unclean.
en.R: During her period, anything she lies on or sits on becomes unclean.

es.L: Y todo aquello sobre lo que se acueste en su impureza menstrual será impuro, y todo aquello sobre lo que se siente será impuro.
es.B: Durante su menstruación, todo aquello sobre lo que se acueste y todo aquello sobre lo que se siente queda impuro.
es.R: Durante su menstruación, todo lo que use para acostarse o sentarse queda impuro.

fr.L: Et tout ce sur quoi elle couchera dans son impureté menstruelle sera impur, et tout ce sur quoi elle s’assiéra sera impur.
fr.B: Pendant ses règles, tout ce sur quoi elle se couche et tout ce sur quoi elle s’assied devient impur.
fr.R: Pendant ses règles, tout ce sur quoi elle se couche ou s’assied devient impur.

sw.L: Na kila kitu atakacholalia katika unajisi wa hedhi yake kitakuwa najisi, na kila kitu atakachokalia kitakuwa najisi.
sw.B: Wakati wa hedhi yake, kitu chochote anachokilalia na kitu chochote anachokikalia kinakuwa najisi.
sw.R: Wakati wa hedhi yake, kitu chochote anachokilalia au kukikalia kinakuwa najisi.

decisions.choice: lies on ... sits on: as for the man with a discharge
decisions.reason: The rule matches verse 4 for the man with a discharge.

source.text: וְכָל־הַנֹּגֵ֖עַ בְּמִשְׁכָּבָ֑הּ יְכַבֵּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃

records.literal_gloss: And everyone touching her bed will wash his garments and bathe in water and will be unclean until the evening.

en.L: And everyone who touches her bed will wash his garments and bathe in water and be unclean until the evening.
en.B: Whoever touches her bed is to wash their clothes and bathe in water, and they remain unclean until evening.
en.R: Anyone who touches her bed becomes unclean. They must wash their clothes and take a bath. They will be unclean until evening.

es.L: Y todo el que toque su cama lavará sus ropas y se bañará en agua, y quedará impuro hasta la tarde.
es.B: Quien toque su cama lavará su ropa y se bañará en agua, y quedará impuro hasta la tarde.
es.R: Quien toque su cama queda impuro. Tiene que lavar su ropa y bañarse. Quedará impuro hasta la tarde.

fr.L: Et quiconque touchera son lit lavera ses vêtements et se baignera dans l’eau, et sera impur jusqu’au soir.
fr.B: Quiconque touche son lit lavera ses vêtements et se baignera dans l’eau, et il restera impur jusqu’au soir.
fr.R: Quiconque touche son lit devient impur. Il doit laver ses vêtements et prendre un bain. Il restera impur jusqu’au soir.

sw.L: Na kila mtu atakayegusa kitanda chake atafua nguo zake na kuoga kwa maji, naye atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni.
sw.B: Mtu yeyote anayegusa kitanda chake atafua nguo zake na kuoga kwa maji, naye atabaki najisi mpaka jioni.
sw.R: Mtu yeyote anayegusa kitanda chake anakuwa najisi. Lazima afue nguo zake na kuoga. Atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni.

decisions.choice: touching her bed: washing as well as waiting
decisions.reason: As in verse 5, touching the bed requires washing clothes and bathing, which touching the woman herself does not (verse 19).

source.text: וְכָל־הַנֹּגֵ֔עַ בְּכָל־כְּלִ֖י אֲשֶׁר־תֵּשֵׁ֣ב עָלָ֑יו יְכַבֵּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃

records.literal_gloss: And everyone touching any article which she sits on it will wash his garments and bathe in water and will be unclean until the evening.

en.L: And everyone who touches any object on which she sits will wash his garments and bathe in water and be unclean until the evening.
en.B: Whoever touches any object she has sat on is to wash their clothes and bathe in water, and they remain unclean until evening.
en.R: Anyone who touches something she has sat on becomes unclean. They must wash their clothes and take a bath. They will be unclean until evening.

es.L: Y todo el que toque cualquier objeto sobre el que ella se siente lavará sus ropas y se bañará en agua, y quedará impuro hasta la tarde.
es.B: Quien toque cualquier objeto sobre el que ella se haya sentado lavará su ropa y se bañará en agua, y quedará impuro hasta la tarde.
es.R: Quien toque algo en lo que ella se haya sentado queda impuro. Tiene que lavar su ropa y bañarse. Quedará impuro hasta la tarde.

fr.L: Et quiconque touchera un objet quelconque sur lequel elle s’assied lavera ses vêtements et se baignera dans l’eau, et sera impur jusqu’au soir.
fr.B: Quiconque touche un objet sur lequel elle s’est assise lavera ses vêtements et se baignera dans l’eau, et il restera impur jusqu’au soir.
fr.R: Quiconque touche une chose sur laquelle elle s’est assise devient impur. Il doit laver ses vêtements et prendre un bain. Il restera impur jusqu’au soir.

sw.L: Na kila mtu atakayegusa kitu chochote anachokikalia atafua nguo zake na kuoga kwa maji, naye atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni.
sw.B: Mtu yeyote anayegusa kitu chochote alichokikalia atafua nguo zake na kuoga kwa maji, naye atabaki najisi mpaka jioni.
sw.R: Mtu yeyote anayegusa kitu alichokikalia anakuwa najisi. Lazima afue nguo zake na kuoga. Atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni.

decisions.choice: any article she sits on: as in verse 6
decisions.reason: The rule for her seat matches the one for the man's seat in verse 6.

source.text: וְאִ֨ם עַֽל־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֜ב ה֗וּא א֧וֹ עַֽל־הַכְּלִ֛י אֲשֶׁר־הִ֥וא יֹשֶֽׁבֶת־עָלָ֖יו בְּנָגְעוֹ־ב֑וֹ יִטְמָ֖א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃

records.literal_gloss: And if on the bed it [is] or on the article which she [is] sitting on it, when he touches it he will be unclean until the evening.

en.L: And if it [is] on the bed or on the object on which she sits, when he touches it, he will be unclean until the evening.
en.B: Even if something is lying on her bed or on the seat she uses, whoever touches it will be unclean until evening.
en.R: Something may be lying on her bed or on the seat she uses. Anyone who touches that thing will be unclean until evening.

es.L: Y si eso [está] sobre la cama o sobre el objeto en que ella se sienta, cuando él lo toque, quedará impuro hasta la tarde.
es.B: Aunque se trate de algo que está sobre su cama o sobre el asiento que ella usa, quien lo toque quedará impuro hasta la tarde.
es.R: Puede haber algo sobre su cama o sobre el asiento que ella usa. Quien toque esa cosa quedará impuro hasta la tarde.

fr.L: Et si cela [est] sur le lit ou sur l’objet sur lequel elle est assise, quand il le touchera, il sera impur jusqu’au soir.
fr.B: Même si une chose est posée sur son lit ou sur le siège dont elle se sert, quiconque la touche sera impur jusqu’au soir.
fr.R: Il peut y avoir une chose posée sur son lit ou sur le siège dont elle se sert. Quiconque touche cette chose sera impur jusqu’au soir.

sw.L: Na ikiwa [kitu] kiko juu ya kitanda au juu ya kitu anachokikalia, atakapokigusa, atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni.
sw.B: Hata kama ni kitu kilichowekwa juu ya kitanda chake au juu ya kiti anachokitumia, mtu yeyote anayekigusa atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni.
sw.R: Huenda kuna kitu kilichowekwa juu ya kitanda chake au juu ya kiti anachokitumia. Mtu yeyote anayekigusa kitu hicho atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni.

decisions.choice: it: something lying on her bed or seat
alternatives: the woman's blood on the bed or seat
decisions.reason: "It" has nothing it plainly refers to. Read most simply, it is an object on her bed or seat: touching it makes a person unclean until evening, without washing, a lighter case than touching the bed itself (verses 21-22). Others take "it" to be the bed or seat, which repeats verses 21-22, or the woman herself on them. The Hebrew is unclear.

decisions.choice: whoever / anyone
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "he" is any person who touches it, so Balanced and Readable use inclusive words. Literal keeps "he".

source.text: וְאִ֡ם שָׁכֹב֩ יִשְׁכַּ֨ב אִ֜ישׁ אֹתָ֗הּ וּתְהִ֤י נִדָּתָהּ֙ עָלָ֔יו וְטָמֵ֖א שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים וְכָל־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֛ב אֲשֶׁר־יִשְׁכַּ֥ב עָלָ֖יו יִטְמָֽא׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And if indeed lies a man with her and is her menstrual impurity on him, and he will be unclean seven days, and every bed which he lies on it will be unclean.

en.L: And if a man indeed lies with her and her menstrual impurity is on him, he will be unclean seven days, and every bed on which he lies will be unclean.
en.B: If a man actually lies with her and the impurity of her period gets on him, he will be unclean seven days. Every bed he lies on will also become unclean.
en.R: A man may sleep with a woman during her period, and her blood may get on him. Then he will be unclean for seven days. Any bed he lies on will become unclean too.

es.L: Y si un hombre de veras se acuesta con ella y su impureza menstrual está sobre él, quedará impuro siete días, y toda cama en que se acueste será impura.
es.B: Si un hombre llega a acostarse con ella y la impureza de su menstruación cae sobre él, quedará impuro siete días. Toda cama en la que se acueste también quedará impura.
es.R: Puede ser que un hombre tenga relaciones con una mujer durante su menstruación, y que la sangre de ella le caiga encima. Entonces él quedará impuro durante siete días. Toda cama en la que se acueste quedará impura también.

fr.L: Et si un homme couche vraiment avec elle et que son impureté menstruelle soit sur lui, il sera impur sept jours, et tout lit sur lequel il couchera sera impur.
fr.B: Si un homme couche réellement avec elle et que l’impureté de ses règles vient sur lui, il sera impur sept jours. Tout lit sur lequel il se couche deviendra impur lui aussi.
fr.R: Il peut arriver qu’un homme couche avec une femme pendant ses règles, et que son sang vienne sur lui. Alors il sera impur pendant sept jours. Tout lit sur lequel il se couche deviendra impur aussi.

sw.L: Na ikiwa mwanamume atalala naye kweli na unajisi wa hedhi yake ukawa juu yake, atakuwa najisi siku saba, na kila kitanda atakacholalia kitakuwa najisi.
sw.B: Mwanamume akilala naye kweli na unajisi wa hedhi yake ukampata, atakuwa najisi siku saba. Kila kitanda atakacholalia kitakuwa najisi pia.
sw.R: Huenda mwanamume akalala na mwanamke wakati wa hedhi yake, na damu yake ikamgusa. Hapo atakuwa najisi kwa siku saba. Kitanda chochote atakacholalia kitakuwa najisi pia.

decisions.choice: indeed lies with her: has sexual intercourse with her
decisions.reason: The verb is doubled for emphasis: not touching her or sitting where she sat, but intercourse (see verse 18). Her uncleanness then passes to him in full: seven days, like her own, and the power to make his bed unclean.

decisions.choice: her impurity on him: the result of intercourse during her period
decisions.reason: This verse gives the ritual result. Elsewhere such intercourse is forbidden, and if done knowingly is punished with being cut off (18:19; 20:18). The verse may have in view a period that begins unexpectedly, but the text does not say.

decisions.choice: her blood
decisions.reason: Readable says "her blood" for "her menstrual impurity", the thing that would get on him.

source.text: וְאִשָּׁ֡ה כִּֽי־יָזוּב֩ ז֨וֹב דָּמָ֜הּ יָמִ֣ים רַבִּ֗ים בְּלֹא֙ עֶת־נִדָּתָ֔הּ א֥וֹ כִֽי־תָז֖וּב עַל־נִדָּתָ֑הּ כָּל־יְמֵ֞י ז֣וֹב טֻמְאָתָ֗הּ כִּימֵ֧י נִדָּתָ֛הּ תִּהְיֶ֖ה טְמֵאָ֥ה הִֽוא׃

records.literal_gloss: And a woman when discharges the discharge of her blood many days not at the time of her menstrual impurity, or when she discharges beyond her menstrual impurity, all the days of the discharge of her uncleanness as [the] days of her menstrual impurity she will be; unclean she [is].

en.L: And a woman, when the discharge of her blood flows many days not at the time of her menstrual impurity, or when she has a discharge beyond her menstrual impurity, all the days of the discharge of her uncleanness she will be as [in] the days of her menstrual impurity; she [is] unclean.
en.B: A woman may have a flow of blood for many days when it is not the time of her period, or a flow that goes on past her period. All the days of that unclean flow she is to be as she is in the days of her period: she is unclean.
en.R: Sometimes a woman bleeds for many days when it is not the time of her period. Or her bleeding may go on after her period should have ended. As long as she bleeds, she is unclean, just as she is during her period.

es.L: Y la mujer, cuando fluya el flujo de su sangre muchos días fuera del tiempo de su impureza menstrual, o cuando tenga flujo más allá de su impureza menstrual, todos los días del flujo de su impureza estará como [en] los días de su impureza menstrual; ella [es] impura.
es.B: Una mujer puede tener un flujo de sangre durante muchos días cuando no es el tiempo de su menstruación, o un flujo que se prolonga después de su menstruación. Todos los días de ese flujo impuro estará como en los días de su menstruación: es impura.
es.R: A veces una mujer sangra durante muchos días cuando no es el tiempo de su menstruación. O la sangre sigue saliendo después de que su menstruación debía terminar. Mientras sangre, es impura, igual que durante su menstruación.

fr.L: Et une femme, quand l’écoulement de son sang coulera de nombreux jours hors du temps de son impureté menstruelle, ou quand elle aura un écoulement au-delà de son impureté menstruelle, tous les jours de l’écoulement de son impureté, elle sera comme [aux] jours de son impureté menstruelle ; elle [est] impure.
fr.B: Une femme peut avoir un écoulement de sang pendant de nombreux jours en dehors du temps de ses règles, ou un écoulement qui se prolonge après ses règles. Pendant tous les jours de cet écoulement impur, elle sera comme aux jours de ses règles : elle est impure.
fr.R: Il arrive qu’une femme saigne pendant de nombreux jours alors que ce n’est pas le moment de ses règles. Ou bien ses saignements continuent après la fin normale de ses règles. Tant qu’elle saigne, elle est impure, comme pendant ses règles.

sw.L: Na mwanamke, majimaji ya damu yake yatakapotoka siku nyingi wakati usio wa unajisi wa hedhi yake, au atakapotokwa na majimaji kupita unajisi wa hedhi yake, siku zote za majimaji ya unajisi wake atakuwa kama [katika] siku za unajisi wa hedhi yake; yeye [ni] najisi.
sw.B: Mwanamke anaweza kutokwa na damu siku nyingi wakati ambao si wa hedhi yake, au kutokwa na damu kunakoendelea baada ya hedhi yake. Siku zote za kutokwa huko kwa unajisi atakuwa kama alivyo katika siku za hedhi yake: yeye ni najisi.
sw.R: Wakati mwingine mwanamke hutokwa na damu kwa siku nyingi wakati ambao si wa hedhi yake. Au damu inaendelea kutoka baada ya hedhi yake kupaswa kuisha. Muda wote anapotokwa na damu, yeye ni najisi, kama alivyo wakati wa hedhi yake.

decisions.choice: a discharge of her blood many days: bleeding that is not her regular period
decisions.reason: This is the woman's counterpart to the man's discharge in verses 2-15: a lasting flow that is a sign of illness. It may come at the wrong time or carry on past the usual seven days. The woman in Mark 5:25-34, who had bled for twelve years, lived with this law.

decisions.choice: as the days of her menstrual impurity: under the same rules as her period
decisions.reason: While the bleeding lasts, the rules of verses 19-24 apply to her. But because it is an illness, her cleansing at the end follows the man's, with seven days and an offering (verses 28-30).

decisions.choice: "el flujo de su sangre" (L), "un flujo de sangre" (B); "sangrar", "sangrado" (R), through verse 30
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep "flujo", the word used for the man's discharge, so the parallel laws match; Readable says plainly that she bleeds.

decisions.choice: "l'écoulement de son sang" (L), "un écoulement de sang" (B); "saigner", "ses saignements" (R), through verse 30
decisions.reason: The same word as the man's discharge is kept at Literal and Balanced, so that the two laws match as in Hebrew; Readable says plainly that she is bleeding.

decisions.choice: "kutokwa na damu" (B, R), through verse 30
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "majimaji" as for the man; Balanced and Readable name the blood directly, which is the natural Swahili way to speak of it.

source.text: כָּל־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֞ב אֲשֶׁר־תִּשְׁכַּ֤ב עָלָיו֙ כָּל־יְמֵ֣י זוֹבָ֔הּ כְּמִשְׁכַּ֥ב נִדָּתָ֖הּ יִֽהְיֶה־לָּ֑הּ וְכָֽל־הַכְּלִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תֵּשֵׁ֣ב עָלָ֔יו טָמֵ֣א יִהְיֶ֔ה כְּטֻמְאַ֖ת נִדָּתָֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Every bed which she lies on it all the days of her discharge, as [the] bed of her menstrual impurity it will be to her, and every article which she sits on it unclean will be as [the] uncleanness of her menstrual impurity.

en.L: Every bed on which she lies all the days of her discharge will be to her as the bed of her menstrual impurity, and every object on which she sits will be unclean, as [in] the uncleanness of her menstrual impurity.
en.B: All the time the flow lasts, any bed she lies on is to be treated like her bed during her period, and any object she sits on becomes unclean, as it would during her period.
en.R: As long as she bleeds, any bed she lies on is unclean, as it is during her period. Anything she sits on is unclean too.

es.L: Toda cama en que se acueste todos los días de su flujo será para ella como la cama de su impureza menstrual, y todo objeto sobre el que se siente será impuro, como [en] la impureza de su menstruación.
es.B: Mientras dure el flujo, toda cama en la que se acueste se tratará como su cama durante la menstruación, y todo objeto sobre el que se siente quedará impuro, como durante su menstruación.
es.R: Mientras sangre, toda cama en la que se acueste es impura, igual que durante su menstruación. Todo aquello en lo que se siente es impuro también.

fr.L: Tout lit sur lequel elle couchera tous les jours de son écoulement sera pour elle comme le lit de son impureté menstruelle, et tout objet sur lequel elle s’assiéra sera impur, comme [pour] l’impureté de sa période menstruelle.
fr.B: Tant que dure l’écoulement, tout lit sur lequel elle se couche sera traité comme son lit pendant ses règles, et tout objet sur lequel elle s’assied deviendra impur, comme pendant ses règles.
fr.R: Tant qu’elle saigne, tout lit sur lequel elle se couche est impur, comme pendant ses règles. Tout ce sur quoi elle s’assied est impur aussi.

sw.L: Kila kitanda atakacholalia siku zote za majimaji yake kitakuwa kwake kama kitanda cha unajisi wa hedhi yake, na kila kitu atakachokalia kitakuwa najisi, kama [katika] unajisi wa hedhi yake.
sw.B: Muda wote damu inapotoka, kitanda chochote anachokilalia kitahesabiwa kama kitanda chake wakati wa hedhi yake, na kitu chochote anachokikalia kitakuwa najisi, kama ilivyo wakati wa hedhi yake.
sw.R: Muda wote anapotokwa na damu, kitanda chochote anachokilalia ni najisi, kama ilivyo wakati wa hedhi yake. Kitu chochote anachokikalia ni najisi pia.

decisions.choice: as the bed of her menstrual impurity: the same rules as in verse 20
decisions.reason: The verse applies verse 20 to the longer flow.

source.text: וְכָל־הַנּוֹגֵ֥עַ בָּ֖ם יִטְמָ֑א וְכִבֶּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃

records.literal_gloss: And everyone touching them will be unclean, and he will wash his garments and bathe in water and will be unclean until the evening.

en.L: And everyone who touches them will be unclean, and he will wash his garments and bathe in water and be unclean until the evening.
en.B: Whoever touches these things becomes unclean. They are to wash their clothes and bathe in water, and they remain unclean until evening.
en.R: Anyone who touches these things becomes unclean. They must wash their clothes and take a bath. They will be unclean until evening.

es.L: Y todo el que las toque quedará impuro; lavará sus ropas y se bañará en agua, y quedará impuro hasta la tarde.
es.B: Quien toque esas cosas queda impuro. Lavará su ropa y se bañará en agua, y quedará impuro hasta la tarde.
es.R: Quien toque esas cosas queda impuro. Tiene que lavar su ropa y bañarse. Quedará impuro hasta la tarde.

fr.L: Et quiconque les touchera sera impur ; il lavera ses vêtements et se baignera dans l’eau, et sera impur jusqu’au soir.
fr.B: Quiconque touche ces choses devient impur. Il lavera ses vêtements et se baignera dans l’eau, et il restera impur jusqu’au soir.
fr.R: Quiconque touche ces choses devient impur. Il doit laver ses vêtements et prendre un bain. Il restera impur jusqu’au soir.

sw.L: Na kila mtu atakayevigusa atakuwa najisi, naye atafua nguo zake na kuoga kwa maji, naye atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni.
sw.B: Mtu yeyote anayevigusa vitu hivyo anakuwa najisi. Atafua nguo zake na kuoga kwa maji, naye atabaki najisi mpaka jioni.
sw.R: Mtu yeyote anayegusa vitu hivyo anakuwa najisi. Lazima afue nguo zake na kuoga. Atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni.

decisions.choice: them: her bed and seat
decisions.reason: "Them" refers to the bed and the seat of verse 26; the rule matches verses 21-22.

source.text: וְאִֽם־טָהֲרָ֖ה מִזּוֹבָ֑הּ וְסָ֥פְרָה לָּ֛הּ שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים וְאַחַ֥ר תִּטְהָֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And if she is clean from her discharge, and she will count for herself seven days, and after she will be clean.

en.L: And if she is clean from her discharge, she will count for herself seven days, and after [that] she will be clean.
en.B: Once her flow has stopped, she is to count seven days; then she will be clean.
en.R: When her bleeding stops, she must wait seven days. After that she will be clean.

es.L: Y si queda pura de su flujo, contará para sí siete días, y después [de eso] quedará pura.
es.B: Una vez que su flujo se haya detenido, contará siete días; luego quedará pura.
es.R: Cuando deje de sangrar, tiene que esperar siete días. Después de eso quedará pura.

fr.L: Et si elle est pure de son écoulement, elle comptera pour elle sept jours, et après [cela] elle sera pure.
fr.B: Une fois que son écoulement aura cessé, elle comptera sept jours ; ensuite elle sera pure.
fr.R: Quand ses saignements s’arrêtent, elle doit attendre sept jours. Après cela, elle sera pure.

sw.L: Na ikiwa atakuwa safi kutoka majimaji yake, atajihesabia siku saba, na baada ya [hapo] atakuwa safi.
sw.B: Damu yake ikishakoma, atahesabu siku saba; kisha atakuwa safi.
sw.R: Damu yake ikikoma, lazima asubiri siku saba. Baada ya hapo atakuwa safi.

decisions.choice: is clean from her discharge ... will be clean: the flow stops, then seven days
decisions.reason: As in verse 13, the first "clean" means that the bleeding has ended. Her cleansing follows the man's. The verse does not mention washing, as verse 13 does for him; it may be taken for granted.

decisions.choice: her flow has stopped / her bleeding stops
decisions.reason: As in verse 13, Balanced and Readable say what "clean from her discharge" means.

source.text: וּבַיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁמִינִ֗י תִּֽקַּֽח־לָהּ֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י תֹרִ֔ים א֥וֹ שְׁנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יוֹנָ֑ה וְהֵבִיאָ֤ה אוֹתָם֙ אֶל־הַכֹּהֵ֔ן אֶל־פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: And on the day the eighth she will take for herself two turtledoves or two young ones of a dove, and she will bring them to the priest to [the] entrance of [the] tent of meeting.

en.L: And on the eighth day she will take for herself two turtledoves or two young pigeons and bring them to the priest, to the entrance of the tent of meeting.
en.B: On the eighth day she is to get two turtledoves or two young pigeons and bring them to the priest at the entrance of the tent of meeting.
en.R: On the eighth day she must get two turtledoves or two young pigeons. She must bring them to the priest at the entrance of the meeting tent.

es.L: Y el octavo día tomará para sí dos tórtolas o dos pichones, y los traerá al sacerdote, a la entrada de la Tienda del Encuentro.
es.B: El octavo día conseguirá dos tórtolas o dos pichones y se los llevará al sacerdote a la entrada de la Tienda del Encuentro.
es.R: El octavo día tiene que conseguir dos palomas o dos pichones. Tiene que llevárselos al sacerdote a la entrada de la Tienda del Encuentro.

fr.L: Et le huitième jour, elle prendra pour elle deux tourterelles ou deux jeunes pigeons, et elle les apportera au prêtre, à l’entrée de la tente de la Rencontre.
fr.B: Le huitième jour, elle prendra deux tourterelles ou deux jeunes pigeons et les apportera au prêtre à l’entrée de la tente de la Rencontre.
fr.R: Le huitième jour, elle doit prendre deux colombes ou deux jeunes pigeons. Elle doit les apporter au prêtre à l’entrée de la tente de la Rencontre.

sw.L: Na siku ya nane atajitwalia hua wawili au makinda mawili ya njiwa, naye atawaleta kwa kuhani, mlangoni pa Hema la Kukutania.
sw.B: Siku ya nane atapata hua wawili au makinda mawili ya njiwa na kumletea kuhani mlangoni pa Hema la Kukutania.
sw.R: Siku ya nane lazima apate hua wawili au makinda mawili ya njiwa. Lazima amletee kuhani ndege hao mlangoni pa Hema la Kukutania.

decisions.choice: two turtledoves or two young pigeons: the same offering as the man's
decisions.reason: Her offering is the same as the man's in verse 14.

source.text: וְעָשָׂ֤ה הַכֹּהֵן֙ אֶת־הָאֶחָ֣ד חַטָּ֔את וְאֶת־הָאֶחָ֖ד עֹלָ֑ה וְכִפֶּ֨ר עָלֶ֤יהָ הַכֹּהֵן֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה מִזּ֖וֹב טֻמְאָתָֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And will offer the priest the one [as] a sin offering and the one [as] a burnt offering, and will make atonement for her the priest before Yahweh from the discharge of her uncleanness.

en.L: And the priest will offer the one [as] a sin offering and the other [as] a burnt offering, and the priest will make atonement for her before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for the discharge of her uncleanness.'
en.B: The priest is to offer one bird as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering, and so make atonement for her before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} on account of her unclean flow.'
en.R: The priest must offer one bird as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering. In this way the priest will make atonement for the woman before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} because of her bleeding.'

es.L: Y el sacerdote ofrecerá uno [como] sacrificio por el pecado y el otro [como] holocausto, y el sacerdote hará expiación por ella delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} por el flujo de su impureza.”
es.B: El sacerdote ofrecerá un ave como sacrificio por el pecado y la otra como holocausto, y así hará expiación por ella delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} a causa de su flujo impuro.”
es.R: El sacerdote tiene que ofrecer un ave como sacrificio por el pecado y la otra como holocausto. Así el sacerdote hará expiación por la mujer delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} a causa de su sangrado.”

fr.L: Et le prêtre offrira l’un [en] sacrifice pour le péché et l’autre [en] holocauste, et le prêtre fera l’expiation pour elle devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} pour l’écoulement de son impureté.”
fr.B: Le prêtre offrira un oiseau en sacrifice pour le péché et l’autre en holocauste ; il fera ainsi l’expiation pour elle devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} à cause de son écoulement impur.”
fr.R: Le prêtre doit offrir un oiseau en sacrifice pour le péché et l’autre en holocauste. De cette façon, le prêtre fera l’expiation pour cette femme devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} à cause de ses saignements.”

sw.L: Na kuhani atamtoa mmoja [kuwa] sadaka ya dhambi na mwingine [kuwa] sadaka ya kuteketezwa, na kuhani atafanya upatanisho kwa ajili yake mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa sababu ya majimaji ya unajisi wake.'
sw.B: Kuhani atamtoa ndege mmoja kuwa sadaka ya dhambi na mwingine kuwa sadaka ya kuteketezwa, na hivyo atamfanyia upatanisho mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa sababu ya kutokwa kwake na damu kulikomtia unajisi.'
sw.R: Lazima kuhani amtoe ndege mmoja kuwa sadaka ya dhambi na mwingine kuwa sadaka ya kuteketezwa. Kwa njia hii kuhani atamfanyia mwanamke huyo upatanisho mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa sababu ya kutokwa kwake na damu.'

decisions.choice: make atonement for her: cleanse her from the uncleanness of her flow
decisions.reason: As in verse 15 and 12:7, the offerings cleanse an uncleanness that was no sin. The words to be passed on to the people end here; verse 31 speaks again to Moses and Aaron.

source.text: וְהִזַּרְתֶּ֥ם אֶת־בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִטֻּמְאָתָ֑ם וְלֹ֤א יָמֻ֨תוּ֙ בְּטֻמְאָתָ֔ם בְּטַמְּאָ֥ם אֶת־מִשְׁכָּנִ֖י אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּתוֹכָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will separate [the] sons of Israel from their uncleanness, and not they will die in their uncleanness in their making unclean my tabernacle which [is] in their midst.

en.L: And you will keep the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel separate from their uncleanness, so that they do not die in their uncleanness by making {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} tabernacle that [is] in their midst unclean.
en.B: You must keep the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} apart from their uncleanness, so that it does not bring death on them when they defile {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} tabernacle, which is among them.
en.R: You must keep the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} separate from what makes them unclean. Then they will not die for making {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} tent unclean, the tent that is here among them.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} {{plural_you:mantendrán|mantendréis}} a los hijos de Israel separados de su impureza, para que no mueran en su impureza al contaminar {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} tabernáculo que [está] en medio de ellos.
es.B: {{plural_you:Ustedes|Vosotros}} {{plural_you:deben|debéis}} mantener a los israelitas apartados de su impureza, para que esta no les traiga la muerte cuando contaminen {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} tabernáculo, que está entre ellos.
es.R: {{plural_you:Ustedes|Vosotros}} {{plural_you:deben|debéis}} mantener a los israelitas lejos de lo que los hace impuros. Así no morirán por contaminar {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} tienda, la tienda que está aquí en medio de ellos.

fr.L: Et vous tiendrez les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël séparés de leur impureté, afin qu’ils ne meurent pas dans leur impureté en rendant impure {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} Demeure qui [est] au milieu d’eux.
fr.B: Vous devez tenir les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} à l’écart de leur impureté, pour qu’elle ne leur apporte pas la mort quand ils souillent {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} Demeure, qui est parmi eux.
fr.R: Vous devez garder les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} loin de ce qui les rend impurs. Ainsi, ils ne mourront pas pour avoir rendu impure {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} tente, la tente qui est ici au milieu d’eux.

sw.L: Na mtawatenga wana wa Israeli na unajisi wao, ili wasife katika unajisi wao kwa kuitia unajisi maskani {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} iliyo katikati yao.
sw.B: Ni lazima mwatenge Waisraeli mbali na unajisi wao, ili unajisi huo usiwaletee kifo wanapoitia unajisi maskani {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, iliyo kati yao.
sw.R: Ni lazima mwaweke Waisraeli mbali na kile kinachowatia unajisi. Hapo hawatakufa kwa kulitia unajisi hema {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}, hema lililoko hapa katikati yao.

decisions.choice: you will separate: Moses and Aaron, and the priests after them
decisions.reason: "You" is plural. The speech turns from the words for the people (verses 2-30) back to Moses and Aaron (verse 1), who are to see that the people keep these laws. Teaching the difference between clean and unclean is the priests' task (10:10-11).

decisions.choice: separate from their uncleanness: keep them from bringing uncleanness near holy things
decisions.reason: The verb means to set apart or hold back, and is related to the word for a Nazirite, one set apart (Numbers 6:2). The people are not kept away from all uncleanness, which these laws treat as part of life, but from carrying it to the sanctuary. The Septuagint has "make them cautious", as if from a similar verb meaning to warn.

decisions.choice: defile my tabernacle among them: the danger of uncleanness is to God's dwelling
decisions.reason: God's tabernacle, his dwelling, stood in the middle of the camp, because he had chosen to live among his people (Exodus 25:8; 29:45-46). Uncleanness is not sin, but holy and unclean must not meet: when they do, the dwelling is defiled, and those who defile it may die (22:3, 9; Numbers 19:13, 20). This is why these laws are given, and why the sanctuary is cleansed every year from the uncleanness of the people (16:16, 19).

decisions.choice: so that it does not bring death on them
decisions.reason: Balanced makes the uncleanness the cause of death, which is what "die in their uncleanness" means, to avoid echoing a familiar wording.

decisions.choice: my tent ... the tent that is here among them
decisions.reason: Readable calls the tabernacle God's tent (as 17:4 does) and repeats "the tent" to keep the sentence clear.

records.literal_gloss: This [is the] law of the [one] discharging, and [of the one] who goes out from him a laying of seed to be unclean by it,

en.L: This [is] the law of the one with a discharge, and of [the one] from whom an emission of semen goes out, so that he is unclean by it,
en.B: These are the instructions for the man with a discharge, for a man whose semen comes out from him and makes him unclean,
en.R: These are the rules for a man who has a discharge. They are also for a man who becomes unclean when his semen comes out.

es.L: Esta [es] la ley del que tiene flujo, y de [aquel] de quien sale emisión de semen, de modo que queda impuro por ella,
es.B: Estas son las instrucciones para el hombre que tiene flujo, para el hombre a quien le sale semen y lo hace impuro,
es.R: Estas son las normas para un hombre que tiene un flujo. También son para un hombre que queda impuro cuando le sale el semen.

fr.L: Telle [est] la loi de celui qui a un écoulement, et de [celui] de qui sort une émission de semence, de sorte qu’il en est impur,
fr.B: Telles sont les instructions pour l’homme qui a un écoulement, pour l’homme dont la semence sort et le rend impur,
fr.R: Voici les règles pour un homme qui a un écoulement. Elles sont aussi pour un homme qui devient impur quand sa semence sort.

sw.L: Hii [ndiyo] sheria ya yule anayetokwa na majimaji, na ya [yule] ambaye shahawa zinamtoka, hata akawa najisi kwa hizo,
sw.B: Haya ndiyo maelekezo kuhusu mwanamume anayetokwa na majimaji, na mwanamume anayetokwa na shahawa zikamfanya kuwa najisi,
sw.R: Hizi ndizo taratibu za mwanamume anayetokwa na majimaji. Ni pia kwa ajili ya mwanamume anayekuwa najisi shahawa zake zinapotoka.

decisions.choice: this is the law: the closing summary of the chapter
decisions.reason: Verses 32-33 are one sentence that sums up the chapter, in the order of its cases: the man with a discharge (verses 2-15), the emission of semen (verses 16-18), the woman's period (verses 19-24), the long flow of either sex (verses 2-15, 25-30), and the man who lies with a woman in her period (verse 24). Like 7:37, 11:46 and 14:54-57, it names what the laws cover.

en.R: They are for a woman during her monthly period, and for any man or woman who has a discharge. And they are for a man who sleeps with a woman while she is unclean."

decisions.choice: the one who is ill: the woman during her period
decisions.reason: The word means faint or unwell (Lamentations 1:13; 5:17). Here it describes the woman in her period, without calling it a sickness like the long flow of verse 25.

decisions.choice: the one discharging, male and female: both kinds of long flow
decisions.reason: "For the male and for the female" gathers up the man's discharge (verses 2-15) and the woman's long flow (verses 25-30), which the chapter treats alike.

decisions.choice: a man who lies with an unclean woman: the case of verse 24
decisions.reason: The last case is the man of verse 24. With it the summary and the speech of verse 1 end.

decisions.choice: a woman while she is unclean
decisions.reason: Literal brackets "[woman]"; Balanced and Readable name her and make clear that the uncleanness is hers.

decisions.choice: "indispuesta"
decisions.reason: "Indispuesta" is the usual discreet Spanish word for a woman during her period and, like the Hebrew, does not call it an illness.

decisions.choice: "para el varón y para la mujer"
alternatives: para el macho y para la hembra
decisions.reason: "Macho" and "hembra" sound like words for animals when said of people; "varón" keeps the Hebrew "male" with dignity.

decisions.choice: "souffrante" (L); "indisposée" (B)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word means faint or unwell without calling the period an illness; "indisposée" is the usual discreet French word for a woman during her period.

decisions.choice: "pour l'homme et pour la femme"
alternatives: pour le mâle et pour la femelle
decisions.reason: In French "mâle" and "femelle" are said of animals; for people the plain words keep the sense without sounding coarse.
